row:
🐾 Jai Kalbhairav Namah 🐾
Rescuing. Healing. Rehoming.
We are not just a shelter — we are a lifeline for those who cannot speak.
Every day, we rescue animals who are:
Severely injured
Abandoned and starving
Fighting infections, maggots, and pain
Left behind with no hope
We provide them:
Emergency medical treatment
Daily food and care
Safe shelter and recovery
A second chance at life
💔 The reality:
Medical care, food, and shelter costs are rising daily. Many lives depend on timely help, and sometimes saving even one becomes a challenge.
🙏 Your support can save lives:
₹50 feeds a dog
₹500 supports basic treatment
₹1000+ helps with surgeries and critical care
Every rupee brings hope.
🐶 On this channel, you will see:
Rescue missions
Recovery journeys
Adoption stories
Shelter life & awareness
✨ Every rescue is a second chance. Every life matters.
🤍 Be their voice. Be their hope.
👉 Donate. Share. Subscribe. Support.
"मुक्या जीवांची सेवा, हाच आमचा वसा."
